title: Realizing the normalized morphism from a supported complex
statement: Let B be an abelian category with a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let L be a bounded-below integer-indexed cochain complex and n a natural number, with L.X i a zero object for every i ≠ n. Put X = H^n(Q L), and let S be the literal single cochain complex on X in degree n. Let e : single_n X ≅ Q S be the canonical singleFunctorIsoCompQ followed by the inverse quotientCompQhIso, lifted to the bounded-below derived category. For every f : Q L → single_n X whose H^n map followed by singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso is the identity of X, there exists a cochain map t : L → S such that Q(t) followed by e inverse is f, and iCycles(L,n) followed by t_n and the sole-term identification S.X n ≅ X equals homologyπ(L,n) followed by homologyFunctorObjQIso(L,n) inverse. This statement needs no coefficient functor or Grothendieck hypothesis.

proof.text: The support hypothesis makes the outgoing differential zero. Obtain an invertible cycle inclusion by HomologicalComplex.isIso_iCycles. Define φ explicitly as its inverse followed by homologyπ and the inverse quotient comparison. Construct t with mkHomToSingle φ: any incoming differential has zero source. The mkHomToSingle_f equation and isomorphism cancellation prove the coefficient identity.

proof.text: Expand the canonical single-complex homology isomorphism and cancel the homology quotient comparisons, using DerivedCategory.singleFunctorsPostcompQIso_inv_hom. The canonical e inverse is the identity after applying the fully faithful inclusion. Quotient homology naturality, homologyπ naturality, and the coefficient identity prove that Q(t) followed by e inverse induces the identity on X.

proof.text: Support also gives IsStrictlyGE n and IsStrictlyLE n. Transfer these to Q L via the quotient comparison. Apply the already proved DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor_hom_ext_of_isGE_of_isLE to Q(t) followed by e inverse and f; their homology maps agree by the preceding identity and the normalization hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem supported_complex_single_realization (L : CochainComplex.Plus B) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ (n : ℤ) → IsZero (L.obj.X i)) : let X := (homologyFunctor B n).obj (Q.obj L) let S : CochainComplex.Plus B := ⟨(CochainComplex.singleFunctor B (n : ℤ)).obj X, n, inferInstance⟩ let e : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B n).obj X ≅ DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj S := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimageIso ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ B n).app X ≪≫ (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso B).symm.app _) ∀ (f : Q.obj L ⟶ (singleFunctor B n).obj X), (homologyFunctor B n).map f ≫ (singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso (C := B) n).hom.app X = 𝟙 X → ∃ (t : L ⟶ S), Q.map t ≫ e.inv = f ∧ L.obj.iCycles n ≫ t.hom.f n ≫ (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n X).hom = L.obj.homologyπ n ≫ (homologyFunctorObjQIso L n).inv
